title: TenderLinterFinding
description: Schema representing a single Tender Linter finding, discrepancy, regulatory violation, or compliance risk.

finding_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the finding (e.g., 'FIND_001').

severity.description: Risk impact level of the finding on procurement legality, audit integrity, and physical safety.

finding_type.description: Controlled taxonomy of procurement compliance discrepancies.

title.description: Short, informative headline for the finding (e.g., 'Superseded Structural Steel Standard Cited', 'Mandatory QCO ISI Mark Omitted').

tender_text.description: Verbatim excerpt from the tender specification containing the issue or clause.

affected_requirement.description: Reference to the extracted tender requirement involved.

requirement_id.description: Identifier matching a RequirementItem in requirements.schema.json.

tender_clause.description: Clause or page reference in tender document.

affected_standard.description: Reference to the Indian Standard involved in this finding.

version_cited.description: Version or year as cited in tender (e.g., '1999').

current_status.description: Current lifecycle status of the standard.

replacement_standard.description: Current valid standard code if superseded (e.g., 'IS 2062:2011').

explanation.description: Detailed technical explanation explaining why this clause is non-compliant, outdated, or risky.

evidence.description: Grounding facts, citations, and regulatory provisions supporting the finding.

standard_clause_reference.description: Specific clause or table in the BIS standard.

qco_order_number.description: Gazette notification S.O. number if related to a mandatory QCO.

factual_summary.description: Concise factual statement of ground truth.

source.description: Provenance metadata identifying the regulatory rule or official source backing this finding.

official_url.description: Link to official BIS or Ministry Gazette reference.

suggested_fix.description: Actionable rectification proposed for the procurement officer.

replacement_clause_text.description: Ready-to-use replacement wording for the tender specification.

recommended_action_summary.description: Instruction for the drafting officer (e.g., 'Update cited standard to IS 2062:2011 Grade E250 and insert mandatory ISI mark requirement').

confidence.description: Confidence score of this finding (1.0 for deterministic rule matches; 0.0-1.0 for AI-assisted extractions).

requires_human_review.description: Flag indicating whether a procurement officer must review and approve this finding prior to final tender publication.

resolution_status.description: Procurement officer review status for this finding.

officer_justification.description: Written rationale provided by the officer if this finding was overridden, rejected, or accepted with remarks.

resolved_by.description: Identity, designation, or employee ID of the reviewing procurement officer.

resolved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when human resolution was recorded.
